paite: Elihu mah in agenzom zel a, hichi in achi:
english: Elihu also continued, and said,

paite: "Hon na thuakzou zek inla, huan ka hon ensak ding; Pathian sik in lah banghiam khat gen ding ka nei ngal a.
english: “Bear with me a little, and I will show you; for I still have something to say on God’s behalf.

paite: Gamla a kipan ka theihna ka hon la ding a, kei hon Bawlpa tung ah diktatna ka nga ding hi.
english: I will get my knowledge from afar, and will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.

paite: Diktak in ka thute zuau ahi kei a; hoihkim khat ka kiang ah a-om hi.
english: For truly my words are not false. One who is perfect in knowledge is with you.

paite: "Ngai in, Pathian in thil ahihthei a, kuamah amusit kei; theihsiamna hatna ah thil ahihthei hi.
english: “Behold, God is mighty, and doesn’t despise anyone. He is mighty in strength of understanding.

paite: Gilou hinna ahawi kei a; himahleh gimthuakte kiang ah adikna uh apia hi.
english: He doesn’t preserve the life of the wicked, but gives justice to the afflicted.

paite: Midiktat a kipan amit alakik kei; himahleh laltutphah tung a kumpipa toh amau tangtawn in akoih a, huchi in hihlet in a-om uhi.
english: He doesn’t withdraw his eyes from the righteous, but with kings on the throne, he sets them forever, and they are exalted.

paite: Huan sikkhaute a gak a a-om ua, gimthuakna guite alak a a-om uleh;
english: If they are bound in fetters, and are taken in the cords of afflictions,

paite: Huchi in athilhih uh amau a- ensak a, atatlekna uh, huchi a kisatheitak a ana omna uh.
english: then he shows them their work, and their transgressions, that they have behaved themselves proudly.

paite: Thuhilhna lam ah abil uh ahonsak a, thulimlouhna a kipan kik ding in thu apia hi.
english: He also opens their ears to instruction, and commands that they return from iniquity.

paite: Amah thu angaihkhiak ua, a-nna asep uh leh, anite uh hauhsakna in ahihbei ding ua, akumte uh kipahna in.
english: If they listen and serve him, they will spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures.

paite: Himahleh angaihkhiak kei ualeh, namsau in amangthang ding ua, huchi in theihna bei in asi ding uh.
english: But if they don’t listen, they will perish by the sword; they will die without knowledge.

paite: "Himahleh amau lungtang a Pathian limsaklouhnate'n hehna akholkhawm hi; amau ahen lai in panpih deih in akikou kei uh.
english: “But those who are godless in heart lay up anger. They don’t cry for help when he binds them.

paite: Tuailai in asi ua, siangloute lak ah ahinna uh amangthang hi.
english: They die in youth. Their life perishes among the unclean.

paite: Agimthuakna in gimthuakte asuaktasak a, nuaisiahna ah abil uh ahonsak hi.
english: He delivers the afflicted by their affliction, and opens their ear in oppression.

paite: Ahi, gakchihna omlouhna, mun lian lam ah dahna a kipan nang ahon pimang ding a; na dohkan tung a kilui thauna in adimta ding hi.
english: Yes, he would have allured you out of distress, into a wide place, where there is no restriction. That which is set on your table would be full of fatness.

paite: Himahleh giloute vaihawmna in na dim a; vaihawmna leh diktatna in nang hon len hi.
english: “But you are full of the judgment of the wicked. Judgment and justice take hold of you.

paite: Thangpaihna a-om ziak in, pilvang in huchi lou in zaw na hauhna in nang ahon pimang kha ding hi; golhgukna tampi in leng nang hon pialsak kei hen.
english: Don’t let riches entice you to wrath, neither let the great size of a bribe turn you aside.

paite: Dahna ana omlouhna ding in, na hauhsaknate ahun diam, ahihkeileh na hatna thilhihtheihna tengteng?
english: Would your wealth sustain you in distress, or all the might of your strength?

paite: Mite tengteng amun ua satkhiak a a-om zan uah lunggulh ke'n.
english: Don’t desire the night, when people are cut off in their place.

paite: Pilvang in, gilou limsak ke'n; gimthuakna sang in hiai lah na telzawta ngal a.
english: Take heed, don’t regard iniquity; for you have chosen this rather than affliction.

paite: "Ngai in, Pathian in athilhihtheihna in sangtak in ahih; amah bang sinsakmi kua ahia?
english: Behold, God is exalted in his power. Who is a teacher like him?

paite: Kua'n amah alampi thu apia a? Ahihkeileh, 'Diklouhna na bawlta,' kua'n achi thei dia?
english: Who has prescribed his way for him? Or who can say, ‘You have committed unrighteousness’?

paite: Mite'n la asak uh, athilhih hihlian ding in theigige in.
english: “Remember that you magnify his work, about which men have sung.

paite: Huai ah mite tengteng a-en ua; huai mihing in gamlapi ah amu hi.
english: All men have looked on it. Man sees it afar off.

paite: Ngai in, Pathian alian a, amah i thei kei; akumte zah zontheih ahi kei.
english: Behold, God is great, and we don’t know him. The number of his years is unsearchable.

paite: "Tui takte ama'n atawi khin a, huai a tuihu a kipan vuah azu.
english: For he draws up the drops of water, which distill in rain from his vapor,

paite: Huai vante'n asungkhia ua, mihing tung ah tampi in atak.
english: which the skies pour down and which drop on man abundantly.

paite: Meipi kiphahte leh a-inn vanpi gingte kua'n atheisiam dia?
english: Indeed, can anyone understand the spreading of the clouds and the thunderings of his pavilion?

paite: Ngai in, akim ah akhovak azak a; tuipi nuai atuam hi.
english: Behold, he spreads his light around him. He covers the bottom of the sea.

paite: Hiaite in mite avai hawmsak a; an tampi apia hi.
english: For by these he judges the people. He gives food in abundance.

paite: Akhutte in khophia atawi a; chiamtehna khoh ding in thu apia hi.
english: He covers his hands with the lightning, and commands it to strike the mark.

paite: Huai husa in atungtang thu agen a, ganhonte'n leng hong kuantou huihpi tungtang thu athei uh."
english: Its noise tells about him, and the livestock also, concerning the storm that comes up.
